subtitle: Markets Closed for Weekend: Summary of Friday, September 4, 2026

items.headline: Jobs Report Fuels Rate Hike Speculation, Leading to Mixed Market Close
items.summary: U.S. equities closed mixed on Friday as a stronger-than-expected August jobs report intensified expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in September. The Dow declined, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq posted marginal gains, reflecting investor caution.

items.headline: August Jobs Report Exceeds Expectations
items.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that nonfarm payroll employment increased by 162,000 in August, significantly surpassing economists' expectations of 55,000 jobs. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1 percent.

items.headline: Strong Jobs Data Fuels Fed Rate Hike Bets
items.summary: Following the robust August jobs report, market pricing indicated that the probability of a 25-basis-point interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve at its September meeting increased to approximately 60%.

items.headline: Technology, Industrials, and Utilities Lead Gains
items.summary: On Friday, only three sectors in the S&P 500 advanced: Technology (+0.44%), Industrials (+0.22%), and Utilities (+0.12%), indicating a selective market performance amidst broader caution.

items.headline: Hurco Companies and Planet Labs Report Earnings
items.summary: Hurco Companies ($HURC) posted a profit in its Q3 2026 earnings, with GAAP EPS of $0.35 and revenue of $47.29 million. Meanwhile, Planet Labs ($PL) beat earnings estimates and raised its full-year guidance, though its stock dipped slightly due to mixed analyst reactions.
